name: video-editing
description: Storyboard-driven video editing with indexed assets, speech, audio post-production, typography, and shared motion/music workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Edit video with indexed assets, speech, sound and typography.
interface.longDescription: Coordinates storyboards, reference analysis, local asset indexing, blending, transitions and keyframes with existing Motion Design and Music Composition. Includes Speech-to-Text, Text-to-Speech, Audio Editing and Typography workflows. Tools, models, fonts and media are selected on use; no services or downloads run on installation.
defaultPrompt: Use $video-editing to storyboard and edit these assets with motion, sound and typography.
Use $speech-to-text to index dialogue and $text-to-speech to generate narration takes.
Use $audio-editing to restore and mix audio, and $typography to index static fonts and lay out titles.
